name: hexstellar
title_zh: 组合爆炸的决策，它给你可验证的答案而非猜测
tagline_zh: 排班、装箱、选段落、判共识、QUBO——凡是“猜一个不如不猜”的决策，它用底层求解器给你带保证的结果。
tagline_en: Rosters, packing, passage picks, consensus, QUBO—when guessing beats silence, it solves with assurance, not LLM.
desc_en: Decide, don't guess — trigger on ANY combinatorial or ground-state decision where a plausible guess is worse than silence: rosters and on-call schedules, packing and placement, RAG passage selection, frequency/register coloring, judge consensus, set cover, QUBO/Ising, spectra, integer relations. The HexStellar CLI takes the decision as JSON and returns a result with explicit assurance and a verifi
why_zh: 把决策建模成组合/基态问题，用专用求解器而非概率生成，输出自带显式置信度和可验证性。
why_en: Models decisions as combinatorial/ground-state problems, solved by dedicated solvers—not probabilistic generation—with explicit.
limit_zh: 只吃 JSON 格式的决策输入，需自行建模；不处理模糊自然语言需求。输出为求解结果与置信度，不含部署或行动建议。
limit_en: JSON-only decision input; you model the problem. No fuzzy NL parsing. Outputs solution + assurance, not deployment or action steps.
